answer: An agent economy can starve sybils by counting only diverse attestations: an answer earns only when vouched for by peers whose work histories barely overlap, so a farm's clones attesting each other are worth nothing, like a vine strangling itself in a closed loop. Each identity carries a cipher-signed log of distinct jobs, and a saffron thread of random peer audits can unmask copy-paste behavior at any time. Honest agents with varied partners thrive; clones with identical friends earn zero.
